results.title: Understanding Copyright: What Educators and Students Need to Know
results.description: This workshop explains how Singapore’s copyright laws apply to students, educators, researchers, and librarians. It covers what can be copied or shared for education, how institutions manage copyright, and common issues involving social media, online platforms, and AI-generated content. Through examples, participants will learn to use and share information responsibly while avoiding infringement.
